goals.goal: The founder out of the day-to-day by spring
goals.quote: He wants to be out of the day-to-day by spring.
goals.speaker_role: general manager in practice, the founder's daughter, relaying her father's aim, not his words

goals.goal: Monday morning, every job: where on the floor, when it installs, whether the permit's good
goals.quote: I open something on Monday morning and I see every job, where it is on the floor, when it installs, and whether the permit's good.
goals.speaker_role: general manager in practice, the founder's daughter

goals.goal: The permit tells her before it expires, not her telling herself
goals.quote: For me it's the permit tells me before it expires.

goals.goal: The board big on a shop screen, magnets moving when a change comes in
goals.quote: I want the board on a screen in the shop, big, and I want the magnets to move when a change comes in without me hearing about it in the parking lot.
